title: Efficient Dynamic Shielding for Parametric Safety Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2505.22104v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Shielding has emerged as a promising approach for ensuring safety of AI-controlled autonomous systems. The algorithmic goal is to compute a shield, which is a runtime safety enforcement tool that needs to monitor and intervene the AI controller's actions if safety could be compromised otherwise. Traditional shields are designed statically for a specific safety requirement. Therefore, if the safety requirement changes at runtime due to changing operating conditions, the shield needs to be recomputed from scratch, causing delays that could be fatal. We introduce dynamic shields for parametric safety specifications, which are succinctly represented sets of all possible safety specifications that may be encountered at runtime. Our dynamic shields are statically designed for a given safety parameter set, and are able to dynamically adapt as the true safety specification (permissible by the parameters) is revealed at runtime. translated_title: 参数化安全规范的高效动态屏蔽
translated_abstract: 屏蔽已成为确保AI控制自主系统安全的一种有前景的方法。算法目标是计算一个屏蔽器，这是一种运行时安全强制工具，需要在安全可能受到威胁时监控并干预AI控制器的动作。传统屏蔽器是针对特定安全需求静态设计的，因此，如果安全需求在运行时因操作条件变化而改变，屏蔽器需要从头重新计算，这可能导致致命延迟。我们引入了针对参数化安全规范的动态屏蔽器，这些规范简洁地表示了运行时可能遇到的所有可能安全规范的集合。我们的动态屏蔽器是针对给定安全参数集静态设计的，并能在运行时随着真实安全规范（由参数允许）的揭示而动态适应。主要算法...
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对参数化安全规范的动态屏蔽方法，通过静态设计参数集并在运行时自适应，避免了传统屏蔽器因需求变化而需从头重算的致命延迟问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dynamic shielding approach for parametric safety specifications, which statically designs over a parameter set and adapts in runtime, avoiding fatal delays from recomputing shields when requirements change.
